restoration_note: The teaching describes the cosmic sphere as a bound prison for falsities-from-evil: the twelve zodia molded from the Five Worlds of Darkness (two per world), fixed in place by the Great Artisan, and traversed by Sun and Moon only by the redemptive economy. Most gaps are short Greek-loan completions split across line-breaks (zodiac names: Aries, Virgo, Scorpio, Taurus; sphaira; kosmos) or formulaic conjunctions/articles. Larger fills are constrained by the chapter's own internal summary at lines 79–84 (parallel cosmogonic formula: ⲛⲧⲁⲩⲡⲗⲁⲥⲥⲉ … ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲙⲡϯⲟⲩ ⲛⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲙⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩ ⲍⲛ ⲧⲥⲫⲁⲓⲣⲁ) and by the recurring affliction-formula ϣⲁⲣⲉ ⲟⲩⲑⲗⲓⲯⲓⲥ ϯⲉⲍⲟ. The lacuna at {9} is the only weakly constrained spot; the partial ⲛⲉ…ⲩ within ~12 chars suggests a relative-verb construction continuing ⲧⲙⲛⲧⲃⲟⲟⲛⲉ + verb + 'in them,' but no parallel pins it; restored at low confidence.

restorations.basis: Completes ⲁϩⲕⲁⲧϩ-ⲟⲩ 'has bound them' (3pl object suffix on ⲕⲱⲧϩ); standard pronominal completion across line-break.

Editor's reading of physical trace (only ⲧ- lost at margin). ⲧⲁⲕⲟ + 3pl. Spiritually = the dark archons drawn/dissolved out of the Five Worlds of Darkness; the chapter's own summary at line 80 uses ⲡⲗⲁⲥⲥⲉ for the same act, confirming the cosmogonic sense even though the verb here differs.
Completes ⲧⲥⲫⲁⲓⲣⲁ (Greek σφαῖρα) split across line-break; 'they were bound in the sphere' is the chapter's leitmotif (cf. lines 21, 81).
Standard conjunction joining the Twins (Gemini, ⲡⲇⲓⲇⲩⲙⲟⲥ/ⲡⲁⲓⲁⲩⲙⲟⲥ) with the Archer (Sagittarius) — the two zodiac-signs of the Smoke-world.
Completes ⲉⲩⲏⲡ 'they are reckoned/belong' split across line-break, opening the Wind-world pair (Bull, Water-Bearer, Scales).
Conjunction in the zodiac-listing pattern X ⲙⲛ̄ Y ⲉⲩⲏⲡ ⲁⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲙ̄- (Cancer + Virgo + Pisces of the Water-world).
Greek ἰχθύς with demonstrative ⲡⲓ-; Pisces is required to complete the Water-world triplet (Cancer + Virgo + Pisces) attested at line 73.
Conjunction pairing Capricorn (preceding) with Scorpio in the Darkness-world; matches the listing formula.
'These are the twelve archons of Wickedness' — closes the enumeration of the twelve zodia just listed; ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲛⲁⲩⲥ is the chapter's standard number.

Continues ⲧⲙⲛⲧⲃⲟ- → ⲧⲙⲛⲧⲃⲟⲟⲛⲉ + relative-verb construction 'whom Wickedness works/operates in.' Length and partial trace ⲛⲉ…ⲩ tolerable; spiritually fits 'these are the twelve archons of Wickedness in whom Wickedness operates.' Weakly constrained.

5-char estimate matches ⲕⲁⲕⲓⲁ exactly. Parallel at lines 51–52: ⲡⲉⲧⲣⲙⲛⲧⲃⲟⲟⲛⲉ ⲛⲓⲙ ⲍⲓ ⲕⲁⲕⲓⲁ ⲍⲛ̄ ⲭⲱⲣⲁ ⲛⲓⲙ ('every evil and wickedness in every region'). The doublet 'evil and wickedness' is the chapter's own formula for the seven planet-makers' operation.
Editor's reading; completes ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ across the bracket and supplies the first ⲉⲓⲧⲉ-clause of the triple ⲉⲓⲧⲉ … ⲉⲓⲧⲉ ⲍⲙ ⲡⲱⲏⲛ ⲉⲓⲧⲉ ⲍⲛ ⲧⲥⲁⲣⲝ.
Standard preposition+article ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ in the formula ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ 'world of the Darkness,' completing Saturn's assignment.
Standard ⲇⲉ ⲍⲱⲱϥ formula matching every parallel planet-clause in this enumeration (cf. lines 41 ⲇⲉ ⲍⲱⲱϥ for Mars, 60 for Taurus, etc.). Continues with ⲱϥ on next line giving ⲇⲉ ⲍⲱⲱϥ.

Completes ⲡⲕⲣⲓⲟⲥ 'Aries' across line-break, opening the fire-triangle plundering description.
Relative prefix ⲉ- on ⲧⲙⲁⲍⲉ 'who are mounted upon him,' continuing the chain of relatives describing the steward and way-leaders.
